central_thesis: In a controlled gallery-only transfer of open-set prototype fitting, good inlier ranking can coexist with harmful accumulated weight from task-external samples.
central_insight: The aggregate mass and composition retained by a prototype update must be examined separately from ranking quality.
analysis_budget_waiver: Early technical note: five analysis questions use four measured evidence groups. A1 and A2 share the original main result. The fourth group is exposed-development calibration transfer, not an independent target confirmation or new OSLO dataset. No novel remedy or submission claim.
warnings: paper_view.core_claims has more than three claims; consider narrowing the paper
